sloka: कस्य चिन्न हि दुर्बुद्धेश्छन्दतो जायते मतिः ।देवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतो दैवेन हन्यते ।यादृशं कुरुते कर्म तादृशं फलमश्नुते ।। ७.१५.२५ ॥
transliteration: kasya cinna hi durbuddheśchandato jāyate matiḥ ।devaṁ ceṣṭayate sarvaṁ hato daivena hanyate ।yādṛśaṁ kurute karma tādṛśaṁ phalamaśnute ।। 7.15.25 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the intellect of an evil-minded person does not arise by their own will, for destiny directs everything, and one struck by fate is destroyed, ultimately receiving the fruit corresponding to the actions one performs.
